15. (Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is dynamically generated based on real-time server load and availability metrics__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker that evaluates the information prior to routing the client request__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __that is distinct from and separate from the resource identifier__, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature __transmitted separately from the resource locator__ identifying a media request __to the media request broker__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, __further comprising the step of the media request broker receiving the information added to the locator and__ providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __received from the locator, wherein the selection criteria include at least one of: server processing capacity, network bandwidth availability, or geographic proximity to the client computer__.

24. (Currently Amended) A system of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a client computer; a first set of one or more server computers in a computer network accessible by the client computer through a path including one or more server computers; a second server computer __configured to generate and maintain__ a resource locator with information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set one or more server computers __dynamically updated based on real-time server metrics__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and a selector __module or component__ for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selector is implemented as a media request broker that evaluates server availability prior to routing requests__.

25. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 24, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __that is distinct from the resource identifier__, the system further comprising circuitry for selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser this http request containing the unique signature __transmitted separately from the resource locator__ identifying a media request __directed to the media request broker__.

27. (Currently Amended) A computer program product for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising a computer readable storage medium having program code embodied therein, the program code comprising: program code for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; program code for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is dynamically generated based on real-time server load and availability metrics__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and program code for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker that evaluates the information prior to routing the client request__.
